1 1/4 hack squat:
Steps
1. Set up in the hack squat
2. Lower to the bottom, come up a quarter, lower again
3. Stand up
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Keep your back on the pad.
1 1/4 heels elevated goblet squat:
Steps
1. Stand with your heels on a step holding a weight at your chest
2. Squat down, come up a quarter, lower again
3. Stand up
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Keep your chest up.
1 1/4 hip thrust machine:
Steps
1. Set up in the hip thrust machine with the pad across your hips
2. Drive your hips up to full lockout
3. Lower a quarter, drive back up, then lower all the way
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Chin tucked, eyes between your knees.
1 1/4 leg extension:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg extension
2. Extend your legs, lower a quarter, extend again
3. Lower all the way
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Control the movement.
1 1/4 leg press:
Steps
1. Set up in the leg press
2. Lower, push up a quarter, lower again
3. Press up
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Keep your back on the pad.
1 1/4 low row machine:
Steps
1. Sit in the low row machine
2. Pull to your stomach, return a quarter, pull again
3. Return to straight arms
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
1 1/4 lying leg curl machine:
Steps
1. Lie face down with the pad above your heels
2. Curl your heels towards your glutes
3. Lower a quarter, curl back up, then lower all the way
4. That's 1 rep

Tip
Point your heels towards your glutes.
1-2 rhythm jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Do one small pogo hop, then one big jump
3. Keep the rhythm going
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Land on the balls of your feet.
2 rope face pull:
Steps
1. Attach two ropes to a high cable
2. Pull the ropes towards your face, elbows high
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
2 up 1 down - seated cable row:
Steps
1. Sit at a cable row with single handles
2. Row with both arms
3. Let one arm go and lower slowly with the other
4. Switch arms each rep

Tip
Keep your chest up.
2 up 1 down barbell hip thrust on bench:
Steps
1. Sit with your upper back on a bench and a padded barbell across your hips
2. Drive up with both legs
3. Lift one foot and lower slowly on the other
4. Switch legs each rep

Tip
Keep your ribs down at the top.
2 up 1 down goblet box squat:
Steps
1. Hold a weight at your chest in front of a box
2. Squat to the box and stand on both legs
3. Lower to the box on one leg
4. Switch legs each rep

Tip
Control the lowering.
2 up 1 down standing landmine press:
Steps
1. Hold the end of a landmine at your chest with both hands
2. Press it up with both
3. Lower with one hand
4. Switch hands each rep

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
2 up 1 down straight leg calf raise elev:
Steps
1. Stand with the balls of both feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging off and knees straight
2. Rise up onto your toes using both legs
3. Shift your weight onto one leg at the top
4. Slowly lower that heel below the step over 3 to 5 seconds
5. Put the other foot back down and repeat

Tip
Hold a rail or wall for balance so the calf does the work, not your balance.
3 point sprint start:
Steps
1. Get into a staggered stance with one hand on the ground
2. Lean your weight forward over the front foot
3. Drive hard off both feet and sprint
4. Accelerate over the set distance

Tip
Push, don't step.
3 position standing cable fly:
Steps
1. Stand between two cables holding a handle in each hand, split stance
2. Bring your hands together in front of your chest with a slight elbow bend
3. Do reps from high to low, then level, then low to high
4. Return slowly each rep

Tip
Keep your elbows soft and fixed.
3 way slider lunge - forward/lateral/rev:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg with the other foot on a slider
2. Slide forward into a lunge, return
3. Slide out to the side, return
4. Slide back, return

Tip
Stay balanced.
90 degrees chin up iso hold:
Steps
1. Hang from a bar with an underhand grip
2. Pull up until your elbows are at 90 degrees
3. Hold
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
a march - dowel overhead:
Steps
1. Hold a dowel overhead with straight arms
2. March forward, driving one knee up into the A position
3. Land on the ball of the foot
4. Alternate legs

Tip
Stay tall.
a run drill:
Steps
1. Run forward with quick, short steps
2. Drive each knee up to hip height
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Keep going

Tip
Fast turnover and a cyclical leg action.
a skip - dowel overhead:
Steps
1. Hold a dowel overhead with straight arms
2. Skip forward, driving one knee up into the A position
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Alternate legs

Tip
Stay tall with the dowel overhead.
a skip switch - double:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs twice quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a skip switch - single:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs once quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a skip switch - triple:
Steps
1. Stand in the A position
2. Switch legs three times quickly
3. Hold the A position
4. Repeat

Tip
Land on the ball of the foot.
a-skip:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height with your toes pulled up
3. Land on the ball of the foot under your hips
4. Alternate legs with opposite arm drive

Tip
Stay tall.
a-triple switch:
Steps
1. Stand tall in the A position: one knee driven up to hip height, toes pulled up, standing on the ball of the other foot
2. Rapidly switch legs three times, driving the down leg into the ground each time
3. Finish on the third switch and hold the A position for a moment
4. Reset and repeat, starting on the other leg

Tip
Stay tall with your hips high. The ground contacts should be quick and quiet.
acceleration to deceleration back step:
Steps
1. Accelerate forward a few steps
2. Stop sharply with a low, wide stance
3. Step back
4. Reset

Tip
Control the stop. Stay low and use your legs.
accentuated eccentric - dumbbell box jum:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells in front of a box
2. Swing your arms down and drop the dumbbells at the bottom
3. Jump onto the box
4. Step down

Tip
Watch your feet as you drop the dumbbells.
accentuated eccentric - dumbbell jump:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells
2. Drop into a quarter squat and release the dumbbells at the bottom
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Release cleanly and keep your feet clear.
active bar hang:
Steps
1. Hang from a bar with straight arms
2. Pull your shoulders down away from your ears
3. Hold
4. Lower

Tip
Don't bend your elbows.
active recovery:
Steps
1. Choose a light activity such as walking, cycling or easy mobility
2. Keep the effort easy, about 3 to 4 out of 10
3. Keep it going for the set time
4. You should finish feeling better than you started

Tip
A light version of what's prescribed.
alternating box blast:
Steps
1. Stand with one foot on a box
2. Push hard off the box foot and jump up
3. Switch feet in the air
4. Land with the other foot on the box

Tip
A bench or stacked plates works if you don't have a box.
alternating cable single arm iso seated:
Steps
1. Sit at a cable row with single handles
2. Row both in and hold one
3. Row and return the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep tension on the non-working side.
alternating dumbbell z-press:
Steps
1. Sit on the floor with your legs straight holding dumbbells at your shoulders
2. Press one overhead
3. Lower and press the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Sit tall.
alternating incline dumbbell press:
Steps
1. Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells at your shoulders
2. Press one dumbbell up while the other stays at the bottom
3. Lower it and press the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep your shoulder blades back and down.
alternating iso dumbbell seal row - incl:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells
2. Row both up and hold one
3. Lower and row the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep your chest on the bench.
alternating iso-lateral row machine:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine
2. Row both handles and hold one
3. Lower and row the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep tension in your mid-back.
assault bike:
Steps
1. Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom
2. Start pedalling and pushing and pulling the handles
3. Work at the pace or intensity prescribed
4. Ease off to cool down

Tip
Use your arms and legs together.
b-stance barbell hip thrust:
Steps
1. Set up for a hip thrust with one foot forward and one back (toes only)
2. Drive mostly through the front foot
3. Lock out your hips
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Drive off the leg doing the work.
back pedal:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance
2. Run backward with short, quick steps
3. Stay low with your chest over your toes
4. Keep going for the set distance

Tip
Push off the front of your feet.
back squat:
Steps
1. Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet shoulder-width
2. Brace and sit down between your hips
3. Go as low as you can with a flat back
4. Drive up through your whole foot

Tip
Keep your knees over your toes.
backpack squat:
Steps
1. Load a backpack and wear it
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width
3. Squat down
4. Stand up

Tip
Pack it with anything heavy.
backward figure 8 shuffle:
Steps
1. Set up two cones
2. Shuffle and back pedal around them in a figure 8
3. Stay low
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay facing forward.
backward pogo:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Bounce backwards off the balls of your feet
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Fast contacts off the floor.
backwards pogo jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Bounce backwards off the balls of your feet
3. Keep your legs stiff
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Fast contacts off the floor.
backwards roll into hurdler stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with one leg straight and one bent
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward into the hurdler stretch, reaching for your straight leg
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards roll into pancake stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward into a wide-leg pancake stretch, reaching forward
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards roll to hamstring stretch/reac:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs straight
2. Roll back onto your shoulders
3. Roll forward and reach for your toes
4. Hold briefly and repeat

Tip
Roll with control.
backwards squat walk:
Steps
1. Sit into a semi-squat
2. Walk backward staying in the squat
3. Take small steps
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay as low as is comfortable.
band anchored single arm chest press:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height behind you and hold the handle in one hand
2. Take a split stance with the opposite foot forward and brace your trunk
3. Press the band straight forward until your arm is long
4. Control the band back until your hand is beside your chest

Tip
Don't let the band twist your torso. Keep your hips and shoulders square.
band anchored single arm tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high and hold it in one hand with your elbow bent and tucked at your side
2. Keep your upper arm still and push your hand down until your elbow is straight
3. Squeeze the back of the arm at the bottom
4. Let your hand come back up slowly to about chest height

Tip
Only your forearm should move.
band assisted ab wheel roll out:
Steps
1. Kneel with an ab wheel and a band anchored behind you
2. Roll forward slowly
3. Go as far as you can control
4. Roll back

Tip
Use a band that lets you return.
band assisted alternating split squat ju:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead and hold it or wear it under your arms
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Jump up and switch legs in the air
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted alternating split stance p:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted alternating staggered plyo:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position with your hands staggered
3. Push explosively and switch hands in the air
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted counter movement jump (cmj:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Thick band for speed, thin band for less help.

Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Drop into a quarter squat and jump
3. Land softly
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Thick band for speed, thin band for less help.
band assisted nordic curl on the barbell:
Steps
1. Kneel with your heels hooked under a loaded barbell and a band anchored above, around your chest
2. Keep a straight line from knees to head
3. Lower forward slowly as far as you can control
4. Pull back up with your hamstrings

Tip
Thinner band means less help.
band assisted pancake stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide and a band anchored in front of you
2. Hold the band
3. Let the band pull you forward from your hips
4. Hold the stretch

Tip
Keep your back flat.
band assisted plyo push up:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position
3. Push explosively so your hands leave the floor
4. Land and repeat

Tip
The band helps you move faster.
band assisted pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet with stiff legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted razor curl:
Steps
1. Kneel with your heels anchored and a band around your chest from above
2. Hinge at your hips and lower forward
3. Extend your hips as you pull back up
4. Return to tall kneeling

Tip
Move slowly.
band assisted reverse nordic:
Steps
1. Kneel tall with a band anchored behind you, looped around your chest
2. Lean back slowly, keeping a straight line from knees to head
3. Go as far as you can control
4. Return to tall kneeling

Tip
The band helps you on the way back up.
band assisted side to side pogo hop:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted side to side pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted single leg jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Drop slightly and jump
4. Land softly, then switch

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.
band assisted single leg pogo hop:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand on one leg
3. Bounce off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast, then switch

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted split stance counter movem:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Drop and jump, landing in the same stance
4. Jump again straight away

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.

Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Drop and jump
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Thicker bands give more speed.
band assisted split stance pogo jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band overhead for assistance
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
The thicker the band, the faster you'll come off the floor.
band assisted staggered plyo push up:
Steps
1. Loop a band overhead and around your chest
2. Start in a push-up position with your hands staggered
3. Push explosively so your hands leave the floor
4. Land and repeat

Tip
Thick band to move faster, thin band to move a bit slower.
band crossover stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a band around one foot
2. Keep the leg straight and pull it across your body
3. Hold the stretch
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
band external shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm across your stomach
3. Rotate your forearm out away from your body, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
A rolled towel between your elbow and ribs helps keep the elbow in place.
band front raise to pull apart:
Steps
1. Hold a band in front of your hips
2. Raise it to shoulder height with straight arms
3. Pull it apart
4. Return

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
band internal shoulder rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand closest to the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees, forearm pointing out
3. Rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping the elbow pinned
4. Slowly return to the start

Tip
Move from the shoulder joint. Your wrist stays straight.
band lateral neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Loop a band around the side of your head just above the ear, anchored to one side
2. Step away from the anchor until you feel tension
3. Keep your head level and upright, resisting the band pulling it sideways
4. Hold for the set time, then turn around and do the other side

Tip
Breathe normally throughout. Stop if you get any pins and needles.
band neck nod:
Steps
1. Loop a light band around the back of your head and anchor it in front of you
2. Sit or stand tall with your chin level
3. Slowly nod your chin down towards your chest against the band
4. Return to level with control

Tip
Small range, slow tempo. This is about control, not load.
band neck protraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored behind you
2. Glide your chin forward (protraction) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and pull your chin back to neutral

Tip
Move slowly and keep your shoulders still.
band neck retraction + lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Draw your chin straight back (a double chin) against the band
3. Then tilt your ear towards your shoulder
4. Return to centre and let your chin glide forward to neutral

Tip
Keep your eyes level and your shoulders relaxed.
band pallof press side step:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a band at chest height
2. Press it out
3. Step sideways
4. Bring it back and step back

Tip
Keep your trunk stiff.
band prone single leg hamstring curl:
Steps
1. Lie face down with a band around one ankle anchored behind you
2. Curl your heel towards your glute
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your hips down.
band protraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band behind your head and anchor it behind you
2. Walk forward until there's tension, keeping a slight chin tuck
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
The more you lean forward, the harder it gets. Keep breathing.
band pullover in tabletop:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees at 90 degrees holding a band anchored behind you
2. Pull the band from overhead to your hips
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
band resisted alternating split stance p:
Steps
1. Attach bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet, switching legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can with stiff ankles.
band resisted b-stance barbell pin squat:
Steps
1. Set pins just above the bottom of your squat
2. Stand in a B-stance with a banded barbell
3. Lower to the pins
4. Drive up

Tip
Most weight on the front leg.
band resisted back squat:
Steps
1. Set up a back squat with bands
2. Squat down
3. Drive up against the bands
4. Repeat

Tip
Finish fast.
band resisted backwards walk:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored in front
2. Walk backward against the band
3. Take long strides
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
band resisted barbell box squat:
Steps
1. Set up a back squat with bands and a box
2. Sit to the box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Loop bands around heavy dumbbells if needed.
band resisted barbell hip thrust:
Steps
1. Set up for a hip thrust with bands over the bar anchored to the floor
2. Drive your hips up against the bands
3. Lock out
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
band resisted barbell split squat:
Steps
1. Set up a split squat with a banded barbell
2. Lower until your back knee nearly touches
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band resisted bench press:
Steps
1. Loop bands from the bottom of the rack over the bar
2. Set up on the bench with your feet planted and shoulder blades back
3. Lower the bar to your lower chest
4. Press up hard against the bands

Tip
The bands get heavier at the top, so finish fast.
band resisted block pull:
Steps
1. Set the bar on blocks with bands attached
2. Grip it with a flat back
3. Stand up, driving through your legs
4. Lower to the blocks

Tip
Finish fast against the bands.
band resisted cat camel:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a band over your back, held under your hands
2. Round your back up against the band
3. Then arch your back down
4. Repeat slowly

Tip
Move through the whole spine.
band resisted db hinge row:
Steps
1. Hinge forward holding a dumbbell with a band around your back
2. Row the dumbbell
3. Keep your back flat
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your hips back.
band resisted double broad jump:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your hips, anchored behind you
2. Swing your arms and jump forward
3. Land and jump forward again straight away
4. Stick the second landing

Tip
Load up quickly.
band resisted double contact counter mov:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Drop and jump
3. Land and jump again straight away
4. Stick the second landing

Tip
If you don't have pins, loop bands around heavy dumbbells.
band resisted dumbbell bench press:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench with a band across your back, ends held under your hands with the dumbbells
2. Press the dumbbells up against the band
3. Lower slowly to your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your shoulder blades back.
band resisted elevated staggered stance:
Steps
1. Stand on low platforms in a trap bar with bands, feet staggered
2. Grip the handles with a flat back
3. Stand up, driving mostly through the front foot
4. Lower with control

Tip
Use 20 kg bumper plates if needed.
band resisted elevated trap bar deadlift:
Steps
1. Stand on low platforms in a trap bar with bands
2. Grip the handles with a flat back
3. Stand up tall
4. Lower with control

Tip
Taller lifters use the high handles.
band resisted front squat:
Steps
1. Set up a front squat with bands
2. Squat down
3. Drive up against the bands
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows up.
band resisted ghd reverse hyperextension:
Steps
1. Lie face down on the GHD with your legs hanging and a band around your ankles
2. Lift your legs up behind you
3. Squeeze your glutes
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Don't over-arch.
band resisted hand supported safety bar:
Steps
1. Put a banded safety bar on your back and hold the rack
2. Step back into a lunge
3. Drive up and lift your knee to hip height
4. Return

Tip
Stay tall at the top.
band resisted hollow hold:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a band anchored behind you
2. Press your lower back into the floor
3. Lift your shoulders and legs
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
band resisted incline bench press:
Steps
1. Loop bands from the bottom of the rack over the bar on an incline bench
2. Lower the bar to your upper chest
3. Press up hard against the bands
4. Repeat

Tip
Finish fast.
band resisted incline push up:
Steps
1. Put your hands on a bench with a band across your back, ends under your hands
2. Lower your chest to the bench
3. Push back up against the band
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your body straight.
band resisted iso-lateral row - double a:
Steps
1. Attach bands to a heavy object
2. Row both handles towards your hips
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band resisted iso-lateral row - single a:
Steps
1. Attach a band to a heavy object
2. Row one handle towards your hip
3. Squeeze your shoulder blade
4. Return slowly, then switch

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band resisted lateral bound:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on the leg closest to the anchor
3. Bound sideways away from the anchor
4. Stick the landing on the other leg

Tip
Keep your knee over your toes as you land.
band resisted lateral bound + return:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Bound sideways away from the anchor
3. Stick the landing
4. Bound back to the start

Tip
Loop the band around a pole if you don't have a partner.
band resisted lateral jump:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on both feet
3. Jump sideways away from the anchor
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Stay low and push hard.
band resisted lateral pogo hop:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand on one leg
3. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankle.
band resisted lateral pogo jump:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips, anchored to the side
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
band resisted lateral shuffle - continuo:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored to one side
2. Shuffle away from the anchor
3. Shuffle back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low and punch the floor away.
band resisted lateral shuffle to base:
Steps
1. Attach a band around your waist, anchored to one side
2. Shuffle away from the anchor
3. Stop in an athletic base
4. Reset

Tip
A pole works if no partner is available.
band resisted pendlay row:
Steps
1. Set up a barbell with bands
2. Hinge forward with a flat back
3. Row the bar to your lower chest
4. Lower back to the floor

Tip
Keep your back flat.
band resisted pin squat:
Steps
1. Set pins at the height prescribed with a banded barbell
2. Lower to the pins
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Start each rep from a dead stop.
band resisted pogo jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet with stiff legs
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can.
band resisted pogo jump - fight stance -:
Steps
1. Set a band around your hips
2. Stand in your fight stance
3. Bounce forward and backward off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stay in your stance.
band resisted pogo jump side to side:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand tall
3. Bounce side to side off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
band resisted split stance pogo jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Bounce off the balls of your feet
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Get off the floor as fast as you can.
band resisted staggered stance trapbar d:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar with bands, feet staggered
2. Grip the handles with a flat back
3. Stand up, driving through the front foot
4. Lower with control

Tip
Keep your back flat.
band resisted trapbar deadlift:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar with bands attached
2. Grip the handles with a flat back
3. Stand up tall
4. Lower with control

Tip
Finish fast against the bands.
band resisted vertical jump:
Steps
1. Set bands from the floor over your shoulders or hips
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
band resisted vertical jump (cmj) - shou:
Steps
1. Set bands across your body over the opposite shoulder
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
band resisted zercher single leg ghd bac:
Steps
1. Set up on the GHD on one leg, holding a band in the crook of your elbows
2. Lower your trunk
3. Extend back up
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your back neutral.
band retraction neck iso hold:
Steps
1. Place the band around your forehead, anchored in front of you
2. Walk back until there's tension, keeping your chin level
3. Hold your head still against the band for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Keep breathing and don't let your head get pulled forward.
band rhythmic back squat:
Steps
1. Set up a back squat with bands
2. Squat in a smooth, rhythmic tempo
3. Keep going
4. Re-rack

Tip
Nice and rhythmic.
band shoulder dislocation:
Steps
1. Hold a band in front of you with a wide grip
2. Keep your arms straight and lift the band overhead
3. Continue behind your back
4. Reverse back to the front

Tip
More slack helps if you lack mobility.
band standing row:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand
2. Stand tall with a soft bend in your knees and arms straight
3. Pull your elbows back past your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together
4. Slowly let your arms straighten

Tip
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
band wrist pronation - rack set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rack and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm up and rotate your palm down against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm up

Tip
The forearm stays still. Only the hand and wrist rotate.
band wrist supination - rig set up:
Steps
1. Anchor a band low on a rig and hold a dowel or handle with the band attached to one side
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, elbow at 90 degrees
3. Start palm down and rotate your palm up against the band
4. Slowly rotate back to palm down

Tip
Keep your elbow tucked and still.
band-resisted hand-supported safety bar:
Steps
1. Put a banded safety bar on your back and hold the rack
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.

Steps
1. Put a banded safety bar on your back and hold the rack
2. Squat down
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band-resisted quasi-isometric 4-way neck:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your head, anchored to the front
2. Very slowly move your head against the band through a small range, taking 5 or more seconds each way
3. Repeat facing away, then each side, so you train all 4 directions
4. Keep tension on the band the whole time

Tip
Slow is the point. If you can move fast, the band is too light.
band-resisted safety bar box squat:
Steps
1. Put a banded safety bar on your back
2. Sit to a box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band-resisted safety squat bar (ssb) spl:
Steps
1. Put a banded safety bar on your back
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.
band-resisted trapbar drop jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar with bands attached
2. Drop into a quarter squat holding the bar
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
banded collarbone row:
Steps
1. Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Pull it towards your collarbone, elbows high
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
banded external rotations in genie posit:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Lift your arm so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your elbow at shoulder height.
banded iso shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Anchor a band at elbow height beside you, holding it in the hand furthest from the anchor
2. Tuck your elbow into your side at 90 degrees
3. Rotate your forearm out a little and hold that position against the band
4. Hold for the set time, then switch arms

Tip
Push at a steady effort. Don't let the elbow drift away from your side.
banded leg lower:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with both legs straight up and a band around one foot
2. Hold the band to support that leg
3. Lower the other leg slowly towards the floor
4. Lift it back and repeat

Tip
Keep your lower back on the floor.
banded neck backwards shuffle:
Steps
1. Loop a band around your forehead, held by a partner in front
2. Keep your head still
3. Shuffle backward against the band
4. Keep going

Tip
Don't let your head get pulled forward.
banded neck forward shuffle:
Steps
1. Loop a band around the back of your head, held by a partner behind
2. Keep your head still
3. Shuffle forward against the band
4. Keep going

Tip
Keep a slight chin tuck.
banded neck lateral iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the side of your head above the ear
2. Step away until there's tension, standing side-on
3. Keep your head level and resist the band for the set time
4. Turn around and repeat on the other side

Tip
Breathe normally and keep your shoulders level.
banded neck protraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around the back of your head
2. Face away from the rack and step forward until there's tension
3. Keep a slight chin tuck and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step back to release

Tip
Lean forward more to make it harder.
banded neck retraction iso hold - rack:
Steps
1. Loop a band on a rack at head height and around your forehead
2. Face the rack and step back until there's tension
3. Keep your chin level and hold your head still for the set time
4. Step forward to release

Tip
Don't let the band pull your chin forward.
banded prone hamstring curl:
Steps
1. Lie face down with a band around your ankles anchored behind you
2. Curl your heels towards your glutes
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your hips down.
banded quadruped scap push up:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a band across your upper back, ends under your hands
2. Keep your arms straight
3. Let your shoulder blades come together, then push them apart against the band
4. Repeat

Tip
Movement comes from your shoulder blades.
banded scap push up:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with a band across your upper back
2. Keep your arms straight
3. Let your shoulder blades come together, then push them apart
4. Repeat

Tip
Movement comes from your shoulder blades.
banded shoulder external rotation - adbu:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Lift your arm out to the side so your elbow is at shoulder height and bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Slowly lower back to the start

Tip
Your elbow stays at shoulder height the whole time.
banded thread the needle:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a band anchored to one side
2. Hold the band in the far hand
3. Reach it under your body
4. Then rotate open and pull towards the ceiling

Tip
Reach for a deep stretch each rep.
banded worlds greatest stretch:
Steps
1. Step into a deep lunge with a band around your hips
2. Put the inside hand on the floor
3. Rotate and reach your other arm to the ceiling
4. Return and repeat

Tip
Keep your back knee off the floor.
barbell ab roll out:
Steps
1. Kneel holding a loaded barbell
2. Roll it forward slowly
3. Go as far as you can control
4. Roll back

Tip
Keep your back flat.
barbell alternating split stance jump (c:
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Drop and jump, switching legs in the air
3. Land in the opposite split
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay upright and spend as little time on the floor as possible.
barbell b-stance box squat:
Steps
1. Stand in a B-stance in front of a box with a barbell on your back
2. Lightly touch the box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Most weight on the front leg.
barbell b-stance pin squat:
Steps
1. Set pins at quarter squat height
2. Stand in a B-stance with a barbell
3. Lower to the pins
4. Drive up

Tip
Most weight on the front leg.
barbell behind the neck power jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the barbell on your back with a wide grip
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up hard and push yourself under the bar, catching it overhead in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar back to your back

Tip
Keep the dip straight down, chest up.
barbell bench pull - rig set up:
Steps
1. Set a bench on a rig with a barbell below
2. Lie chest down
3. Pull the bar to the underside of the bench
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your chest on the bench.
barbell bent over row - underhand grip:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell with an underhand grip
2. Hinge forward with a flat back
3. Row the bar to your stomach
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your back flat.
barbell bent-over row:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip
2. Hinge forward with a flat back
3. Row the bar to your lower chest
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your back flat.
barbell box squat:
Steps
1. Set up a back squat in front of a box
2. Gently touch the box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't sit and relax on the box.
barbell clean:
Steps
1. Set up with the bar over your mid-foot, clean-width grip, flat back
2. Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees
3. Extend your hips and knees hard and pull yourself under the bar
4. Catch it on your shoulders in a front squat, then stand up

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell close grip floor press:
Steps
1. Lie on the floor under a bar set at arm's length, hands a little narrower than shoulder-width
2. Unrack and lower until your upper arms touch the floor
3. Pause
4. Press back up

Tip
Keep your elbows tucked.
barbell counter movement jump (cmj):
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back
2. Drop into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Load up quickly.
barbell cuban press:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell with a shoulder-width grip, arms hanging
2. Upright row the bar until your elbows are at shoulder height
3. Rotate your forearms up so the bar is in front of your face, elbows still at shoulder height
4. Press the bar overhead
5. Reverse each step slowly to return

Tip
Use a light load. This is a shoulder health drill, not a strength lift.
barbell deadlift:
Steps
1. Stand with the bar over your mid-foot, feet hip-width
2. Hinge down and grip just outside your legs
3. Set a flat back, chest up, and push the floor away to stand
4. Lower the bar down your legs with control

Tip
Keep the bar close to your body the whole time.
barbell deadlift - staggered stance:
Steps
1. Stand with one foot slightly behind the other, bar over the front mid-foot
2. Grip with a flat back
3. Stand up, driving through the front leg
4. Lower with control

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell floating deficit deadlift:
Steps
1. Stand on a low platform with the bar over your mid-foot
2. Lift the bar
3. Lower it to just above the floor without touching
4. Lift again

Tip
Keep tension the whole set.
barbell floor press + bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on the floor with your knees bent under a bar set at arm's length
2. Lift your hips into a bridge
3. Lower the bar until your arms touch the floor
4. Press up, keeping your hips up

Tip
Squeeze your glutes throughout.
barbell floor press - bent knees:
Steps
1. Lie on the floor with your knees bent under a bar set at arm's length
2. Unrack and lower until your upper arms touch the floor
3. Pause
4. Press back up

Tip
Don't bounce your elbows.
barbell floor press - straight leg:
Steps
1. Lie on the floor with your legs straight under a bar set at arm's length
2. Unrack and lower until your upper arms touch the floor
3. Pause
4. Press back up

Tip
Don't bounce your elbows.
barbell front box squat:
Steps
1. Set up a front squat in front of a box
2. Sit to the box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows up.
barbell hip thrust 1 & 1/4:

2. Drive your hips up

Tip
Look between your knees.
barbell jump shrug:
Steps
1. Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip
2. Dip slightly by bending your knees
3. Jump and shrug hard
4. Land softly

Tip
Arms stay long.
barbell kang squat:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell on your back
2. Hinge forward
3. Squat down
4. Stand up through the hinge

Tip
Keep your back flat.
barbell military press - staggered stanc:
Steps
1. Stand in a staggered stance holding a barbell at your shoulders
2. Brace your trunk
3. Press it overhead
4. Lower to your shoulders

Tip
Keep your ribs down.

Tip
Don't lean back.
barbell overhead press - split stance:

1. Stand in a split stance holding a barbell at your shoulders
2. Brace your trunk
3. Press it overhead
4. Lower to your shoulders

Tip
Keep your ribs down.

2. Lower to the bottom
3. Pause
4. Drive up

Feet at or just outside shoulder-width.
barbell paused back squat:
Steps
1. Set up a back squat
2. Lower to the bottom
3. Pause
4. Drive up

Tip
Stay tight at the bottom.
barbell pin squat:
Steps
1. Set pins at the height prescribed
2. Lower to the pins
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Start each rep from a dead stop.
barbell power clean:
Steps
1. Set up with the bar over your mid-foot, clean grip, flat back
2. Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees
3. Extend your hips and knees hard, then pull under
4. Catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell power clean from blocks - below:
Steps
1. Set the bar on blocks just below your knees
2. Set up with a clean grip and flat back
3. Extend hard and pull under
4. Catch on your shoulders in a quarter squat

This can be done on pins.
barbell power clean from pins - above kn:
Steps
1. Set the bar on pins just above your knees
2. Set up with a clean grip and flat back
3. Extend hard and pull under
4. Catch on your shoulders in a quarter squat

Tip
Keep the bar close.
barbell power jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up hard and push yourself under, catching the bar overhead in a quarter squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar to your shoulders

Tip
Re-rack in front of you unless prescribed otherwise.
barbell power step up:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell on your back with one foot on a low box
2. Drive up explosively
3. Step down
4. Repeat

Tip
Bumper plates work as a step.
barbell power step up + hip lock:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell on your back with one foot on a low box
2. Drive up and lift your other knee to hip height
3. Step down
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay tall at the top.
barbell pullover:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest
2. Lower it overhead
3. Pull it back over your chest
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
barbell push jerk:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly
3. Drive up and push the bar overhead, dropping into a partial squat
4. Stand up and lower the bar to your shoulders

Tip
Drive through your legs.
barbell push press - split stance:
Steps
1. Hold the bar in the front rack in a split stance

3. Drive up and press the bar overhead
4. Lower to your shoulders

Tip
Use your legs to start the press.
barbell rdl:

1. Stand holding a barbell at your hips

4. Drive your hips forward to stand

Tip
Bar stays close to your legs.
barbell rocking cossack:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell on your back with a wide stance
2. Shift into a deep side squat on one leg
3. Rock across to the other side
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay as low as you can.
barbell seal overcoming iso row - underh:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on a bench above a fixed bar

3. Pull up into it as hard as you can
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Max effort.
barbell seal row:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on a high bench with a barbell below
2. Row the bar to the underside of the bench
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Raise the bench on plates if needed.
barbell speed bench:
Steps
1. Set up on the bench with a light load
2. Lower the bar to your chest with control
3. Press it up as fast as you can
4. Repeat

Tip
Every rep fast. Stop if the bar slows.
barbell speed deadlift:
Steps
1. Set up for a deadlift with a light load
2. Pull the bar as fast as you can
3. Lower with control
4. Reset each rep

Fast lockout without losing position.
barbell split squat:

1. Set up in a rack with a barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower until your back knee nearly touches
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Set the safety pins.
barbell split squat iso hold:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower until your back knee nearly touches
3. Hold

Tip
Keep your chest up.
barbell split squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land in the same stance

Tip
Stay upright.
barbell split stance jump (cmj):
Steps
1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Drop quickly and jump
3. Land in the same stance
4. Reset

Be explosive. Use a weight that moves fast.
barbell split stance squat jump (ncm):

1. Hold a light barbell on your back in a split stance
2. Lower and pause at the bottom

4. Land softly and reset
