Tip
Stay low.
lateral figure 8 shuffle:
Steps
1. Set two cones
2. Shuffle around them in a figure 8
3. Stay low
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay facing forward.
lateral hop and stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop sideways
3. Land softly on the same leg and stick it
4. Reset

Tip
Brace your abs and glutes as you land.
lateral hurdle hop & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Hop sideways over it
3. Stick the landing on the same leg
4. Reset

Tip
Knee over toes.
lateral hurdle hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Hop sideways over it
3. Hop back straight away
4. Keep going, then switch

Tip
Quick contacts.
lateral hurdle jump to box jump:
Steps
1. Stand beside a hurdle
2. Jump sideways over it
3. Land and jump onto a box
4. Step down

Tip
Short contact between jumps.
lateral jump & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet
2. Jump sideways as far as you can
3. Stick the landing
4. Reset

Tip
Hips back, knees over toes.
lateral jump - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on both feet
2. Jump sideways
3. Land and jump back straight away
4. Keep going

Tip
Quick off the floor.
lateral leg swing:
Steps
1. Face a wall with your hands on it for support
2. Swing one leg across in front of your body, then out to the side
3. Gradually increase the range
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your trunk still. The swing comes from the hip.
lateral pogo hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop side to side off the ball of your foot
3. Keep your knee nearly straight
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle, quick contacts.
lateral shuffle:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle sideways
3. Keep your feet apart
4. Go back the other way

Tip
Keep your weight even on your feet.
lateral shuffle - 2 up 1 back:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle two steps one way
3. Then one back
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
lateral shuffle to crossover sprint:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle a few steps
3. Cross over and sprint
4. Walk back

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral shuffle to linear hop to stick:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance
2. Shuffle sideways a few steps
3. Hop forward on one leg
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral shuffle to sprint:
Steps
1. Start in an athletic position
2. Shuffle a few steps
3. Turn and sprint
4. Walk back

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
lateral sled power shuffle:
Steps
1. Attach a sled to a harness, side-on
2. Shuffle sideways with powerful steps
3. Keep going for the set distance
4. Switch sides

Tip
Powerful steps.
lateral sled sprint:
Steps
1. Attach a sled to a harness, side-on
2. Cross over and sprint sideways
3. Keep going for the set distance
4. Switch sides

Tip
Drive hard.
laying band groin stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a band around one foot
2. Let the leg fall out to the side
3. Hold the stretch
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your hips flat.
laying quad stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your side
2. Bend your top knee and hold your foot
3. Pull your heel towards your glute
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Squeeze your glute.
laying static groin:
Steps
1. Lie on your back
2. Put the soles of your feet together
3. Let your knees fall out
4. Hold

Tip
Breathe and relax.
lean fall sprint:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Slowly lean forward from your ankles
3. Just before you fall, sprint
4. Sprint the set distance

Tip
Stay tall as you lean.
leg extension - 2 up 1 down:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg extension
2. Extend with both legs
3. Lower slowly with one
4. Switch legs each rep

Tip
Control the lowering.
leg extension iso hold:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg extension
2. Extend your legs
3. Hold
4. Lower

Tip
Pull your toes up.
leg press:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg press with your feet hip-width on the platform
2. Lower until your knees are at about 90 degrees
3. Press up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back on the pad.
leg press throw:
Steps
1. Sit in the leg press with a light load
2. Lower the sled
3. Push explosively so the sled leaves your feet
4. Catch it with soft knees

Tip
Only use a machine designed for this. Light load.
linear accel to lateral shuffle:
Steps
1. Accelerate forward a few steps
2. Stop and shuffle sideways
3. Keep going as prescribed
4. Reset

Tip
Stay low in the shuffle.
linear bound + stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound forward onto the other leg
3. Stick the landing and hold
4. Reset

Tip
Knee over toes.
linear deceleration - half kneeling doub:
Steps
1. Half kneel
2. Drive up and take two steps
3. Stop in a lunge
4. Reset

Tip
Stick the stop.
linear hurdle hop - continuous:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a row of hurdles
2. Hop over each hurdle in turn
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Switch legs

Tip
Quick off the floor.
linear hurdle hop to lateral bound:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg behind a hurdle
2. Hop over it
3. Land and bound sideways onto the other leg
4. Stick it

Tip
Quick contacts.
linear lateral bound:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bound forward and to the side onto the other leg
3. Keep bounding forward, side to side
4. Stick the last landing

Tip
Increase the side-to-side distance as you get comfortable.
linear tuck jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Jump forward, pulling your knees to your chest
3. Land and go straight into the next jump
4. Keep going

Tip
Land on the balls of your feet.
loaded ankle dorsiflexion stretch:
Steps
1. Half kneel with a weight on your front knee
2. Rock your knee forward over your toes
3. Keep your heel down
4. Hold

Tip
A dumbbell or kettlebell works.
loaded deadbug reach - tabletop:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a weight over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Reach the weight towards the ceiling
4. Hold

Tip
Breathe out as you reach.
loaded hip switch:
Steps
1. Sit in a 90/90 position holding a weight at your chest
2. Rotate your knees to the other side
3. Keep your chest tall
4. Keep going

Tip
Move slowly.
loaded pancake straddle good morning:
Steps
1. Sit with your legs wide holding a light weight
2. Hinge forward from your hips
3. Return to tall
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back flat.
loaded pistol squat - contralateral:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a weight
2. Squat down on that leg
3. Stand up
4. Repeat

Tip
Weight on the same side as the working leg.
long lunge iso hold:
Steps
1. Step into a long lunge
2. Lower
3. Hold
4. Stand

Tip
Knee behind your toes.
long split squat (atg):
Steps
1. Stand in a long split stance
2. Lower until your front knee passes your toes
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Elevate your foot to keep heels flat.
low row machine - single arm:
Steps
1. Sit in the low row machine
2. Row one handle to your stomach
3. Squeeze your shoulder blade
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your chest up.
lower calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with both hands on the wall
2. Bend both knees, keeping the back heel on the floor
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch low in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch legs

Tip
The bent knee targets the lower calf (soleus).
lying dumbbell tricep extension - double:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows fixed and pointing up.
lying leg curl - 2 up 1 down:
Steps
1. Lie face down in the leg curl machine
2. Curl with both legs
3. Lower slowly with one
4. Switch legs each rep

Tip
Control the lowering.
lying piriformis stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with both knees bent
2. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
3. Pull the bottom thigh towards your chest
4. Hold, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
machine seated alternating chest press:
Steps
1. Sit in the chest press machine
2. Press one arm forward
3. Return and press the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep your back on the pad.
machine seated calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad on your thighs
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heels drop for a stretch, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine seated single leg calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with one foot on the platform and the pad on that thigh
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heel drop, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine standing 2 up 1 down calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the balls of both feet with the pads on your shoulders
2. Rise up with both legs
3. Take one foot off and lower slowly on the other leg
4. Put the foot back and repeat

Tip
Push off the ball of your big toe.
machine standing calf raise - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the ball of one foot, pads on your shoulders
2. Let your heel drop for a stretch
3. Rise as high as you can
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the ball of the big toe.
mcgill curl up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight
2. Slide your hands under the arch of your lower back
3. Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor without bending your neck
4. Hold for 5 to 10 seconds, then lower

Tip
Keep tension through the abs the whole time. Switch the bent leg halfway.
med ball chest pass:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall with a med ball at your chest
2. Push it into the wall as hard as you can
3. Catch it
4. Repeat

Tip
Extend fully through your arms.
med ball rotational throw:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall with a med ball at your back hip
2. Rotate through your hips
3. Throw the ball into the wall
4. Catch and repeat

Tip
Power comes from the hips.
med ball slam:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball overhead
2. Slam it into the floor as hard as you can
3. Pick it up
4. Repeat

Tip
Use your whole body.
medball around the worlds:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball overhead
2. Circle it around your head and body
3. Move through your full range
4. Reverse direction

Tip
Stay in control.
medball back extension on roman chair -:
Steps
1. Set up on the Roman chair hugging a med ball
2. Round your upper back slightly
3. Drive your hips into the pad to come up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Glutes do the work.
medball chest throw to sprint:
Steps
1. Stand holding a med ball at your chest
2. Throw it forward as hard as you can
3. Sprint after it straight away
4. Walk back

Tip
Lean forward into the throw.
medball deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a med ball over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Lower one leg towards the floor
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
medball drop push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Drop quickly into a quarter squat
3. Drive up and throw the ball straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball forward lunge:
Steps
1. Hug a med ball
2. Step forward into a lunge
3. Push back
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your chest up.
medball hip airplane:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a med ball
2. Hinge forward
3. Rotate your hips open, then close them
4. Return

Tip
Focus on control, not speed.
medball push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Dip by bending your knees
3. Drive up and throw the ball straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball rear foot elevated (rfe) split s:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball with your back foot on a bench
2. Lower into a split squat
3. Rotate towards your front leg
4. Return and stand

Tip
Keep your chest up.
medball rocking cossack:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest with a wide stance
2. Shift into a deep side squat on one leg
3. Rock to the other side
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay low.
medball shock push press:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Drop it to your chest and catch it
3. Immediately drive up and throw it straight up
4. Let it land, then reset

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
medball sl rdl:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg holding a med ball
2. Hinge forward
3. Stand back up
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your hips level.
medball squat jump:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball at your chest
2. Lower into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly

Tip
Keep the ball tight to your chest.
medball thoracic extension + lateral fle:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Extend your upper back
3. Bend to one side
4. Return and switch

Tip
Move slowly.
medball thoracic extension + rotation:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball overhead
2. Extend your upper back
3. Rotate to one side
4. Return and switch

Tip
Move slowly.
medial hurdle hop & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg on the outside of a hurdle
2. Hop inward over it
3. Stick the landing on the same leg
4. Reset

Tip
Knee over toes.
medial pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop inward and back off the ball of your foot
3. Keep your knee nearly straight
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle.
medial to lateral hop & stick:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a hurdle
2. Hop inward over it
3. Hop straight back out and stick it
4. Reset

Tip
A yoga block or foam roller works as a hurdle.
middle splits - assisted:
Steps
1. Stand with your legs wide holding support
2. Slide your feet out
3. Go as far as is comfortable
4. Hold

Tip
Use as much assistance as you need.
middle splits - slider:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet on sliders
2. Slide your feet out
3. Go as far as you can comfortably slide back in
4. Return

Tip
Use your hands for support.
mini band clamshell:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with a mini band above your knees, hips and knees bent
2. Keep your feet together
3. Lift your top knee as high as you can without rolling back
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your hips stacked.
mini band glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a mini band above your knees, feet flat
2. Push your knees out against the band
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower

Tip
Keep your knees pushed out the whole time.
mini band lateral squat walk (ankles):
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your ankles
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and don't let your feet come together.
mini band lateral squat walk (knees):
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and keep your knees pushed out.
mini band squat:
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart
3. Squat down, pushing your knees out against the band
4. Stand up, keeping the knees out

Tip
Don't let your knees cave in.
mini hurdle - linear to lateral jump:
Steps
1. Set two mini hurdles in an L
2. Jump forward over the first
3. Jump sideways over the second
4. Stick the landing

Tip
Quick contacts.
mini hurdle hop - linear to lateral to m:
Steps
1. Set mini hurdles in a pattern
2. On one leg, hop forward, then sideways out, then sideways in
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stay balanced.
mini hurdle jump - linear to lateral to:
Steps
1. Set mini hurdles in a pattern
2. Jump forward, then sideways out, then sideways back
3. Keep the contacts short
4. Stick the last landing

Tip
Stay balanced.
miniband - serratus lift:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists and your forearms on a wall
2. Push your wrists apart against the band
3. Slide your forearms up the wall
4. Lift them slightly off the wall at the top, then return

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
miniband barbell box squat:
Steps
1. Put a mini band above your knees with a barbell on your back
2. Sit to a box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your knees out.
miniband eversion:
Steps
1. Sit with a mini band around your feet, heels on the floor
2. Keep one foot still
3. Turn the other foot outwards against the band
4. Return slowly, then switch

Tip
Move only at the ankle.
miniband external rotation + iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Rotate your forearms out against the band and hold for the set time
4. Return slowly

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband external rotation iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Pull your hands apart and hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband goblet box squat:
Steps
1. Put a mini band above your knees holding a weight
2. Sit to a box
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your knees out.
miniband hip flexion - wall leaning:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your feet and lean your back against a wall
2. Stand on one leg
3. Drive the other knee up to hip height against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Stay tall against the wall.
miniband hip thrust on bench:
Steps
1. Sit with your upper back on a bench and a mini band above your knees
2. Push your knees out
3. Drive your hips up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your knees out.
miniband hydrant:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with a mini band above your knees
2. Lift one knee out to the side
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your back flat.
miniband lateral walk:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Step sideways
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
miniband lateral walk - double banded:
Steps
1. Put one mini band above your knees and one at your ankles
2. Stand in a quarter squat
3. Step sideways
4. Keep tension on both bands

Tip
Stay low.
miniband shoulder abduction:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists
2. Stand tall with arms by your sides
3. Lift one arm out to the side against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
miniband shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Rotate one forearm out against the band
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband walk - backwards:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Walk backward
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
miniband walk - forwards:
Steps
1. Put a mini band around your legs
2. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
3. Walk forward
4. Keep tension on the band

Tip
Stay low.
muay thai - heavy bag 50 kicks drill:
Steps
1. Stand in your fight stance at the bag
2. Kick as fast as you can
3. Swing the arm on the kicking side
4. Keep going for 50 kicks

Tip
Turn your hip over.
muscle clean:
Steps
1. Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip
2. Extend hard through your hips and knees
3. Pull the bar up and turn your elbows over without dropping under it
4. Finish with the bar on your shoulders, legs straight

Tip
Keep the bar close.
natera ankle iso ballistic:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar or in a calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar hard
3. Perform small, rapid bounces against the bar from that position
4. Keep the heel high throughout, then switch legs

Tip
Small range, maximum speed.
natera ankle iso push:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar as hard as you can
3. Hold the effort for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
This can be swapped for a standing calf raise machine or a Smith machine.
natera ankle iso switch:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the balls of your feet in a sprint stance, heels just off the floor
2. Push into the bar
3. Quickly switch your legs, keeping the heels high
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Don't let your heels drop as you switch.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hammer:
Steps
1. Stand in the calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the load until your heel is just off the platform
3. Hold that position for the set time without letting the heel sink
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. The aim is to resist the weight, not lift it.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hand su:
Steps
1. Put a safety bar on your back and hold a rack for support
2. Stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - smith m:
Steps
1. Set the Smith bar on your back and stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
neck circles off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench with your head and neck off the end
2. Slowly draw a big circle with your head
3. Complete the reps, then circle the other way
4. Keep your shoulders on the bench

Tip
If your neck pinches in a spot, draw a smaller circle.
neck extension:
Steps
1. Hinge forward or lie face down with your head free
2. Lower your chin towards your chest
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck extension iso hold with weight plat:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the back of your head with both hands
3. Keep your head in line with your spine
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck extension off bench:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head fold forward for a stretch
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom.
neck flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back or sit tall
2. Tuck your chin
3. Bring your chin towards your chest
4. Return slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck flexion iso hold with weight plate:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on your forehead with both hands
3. Keep your head level with your body
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower back for a stretch
3. Pull your chin towards your collarbone
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom of each rep.
neck lateral flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower towards the floor
3. Lift your ear towards your top shoulder
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Get a big stretch between reps.
nordic curl (barbell set up):
Steps
1. Kneel with your heels hooked under a loaded barbell
2. Keep a straight line from knees to head
3. Lower forward slowly
4. Catch yourself and push back up

Tip
Keep your glutes and core tight.
nordic curl - bench assisted:
Steps
1. Kneel with your heels anchored and a bench in front
2. Lower forward slowly
3. Catch yourself on the bench
4. Push back up

Tip
Set the bench at a challenging height.
nordic hamstring curl:
Steps
1. Kneel with your heels anchored
2. Keep a straight line from knees to head
3. Lower forward slowly
4. Catch yourself and push back up

Tip
Lower as slowly as you can.
oblique crunch + adductor squeeze:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a ball between your knees
2. Squeeze the ball
3. Crunch up and across to one side
4. Lower and switch

Tip
Keep squeezing the ball.
offset dumbbell deadbug:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand over your chest
2. Lift your knees to 90 degrees
3. Lower one leg towards the floor
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
offset dumbbell sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Sit up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Don't pull on your neck.
offset dumbbell straight leg sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Sit up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your legs on the floor.
offset hollow hold:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a dumbbell in one hand
2. Press your lower back into the floor
3. Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
open book:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent
2. Reach your arms forward
3. Rotate your top arm open to the other side
4. Return

Tip
Breathe out and go as far as is comfortable.
open gate hip skips:
Steps
1. Skip forward
2. Lift one knee up and rotate it out to the side, like opening a gate
3. Land and repeat on the other leg
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay tall.
oscillatory - bent over band row:
Steps
1. Hinge forward holding a band
2. Row it fast in small pulses
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Return

Tip
As many reps as you can.
oscillatory alternating band row:
Steps
1. Hold a band in each hand
2. Row them fast, alternating arms
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Return

Tip

test - wingate / 30s all-out bike test -:

1. Warm up thoroughly
2. Sprint flat out for 30 seconds
3. Record your result
4. Cool down slowly

Tip
All out from start to finish.
the brettzel:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with the top knee bent in front of you
2. Reach back with your top hand to grab the bottom foot
3. Rotate your chest towards the ceiling
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Breathe into the stretch.
thoracic rotation:
Steps
1. Sit or kneel tall with your hands on your chest
2. Rotate your upper body to one side
3. Return
4. Switch sides

Tip
Keep your hips still.
three position plank:
Steps
1. Hold an elbow plank
2. Then a side plank on one side
3. Then the other side
4. Hold each for the set time

Tip
Keep your body straight.
tibialis raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your back against a wall and your heels about a foot from it
2. Lift your toes as high as you can
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your legs straight.
toe elevated barbell romanian deadlift (:
Steps
1. Stand with your toes on a 2.5 kg plate
2. Push your hips back
3. Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch
4. Stand back up

Tip
Keep the bar close.
toe elevated dumbbell rdl:
Steps
1. Stand with your toes on a plate holding dumbbells
2. Push your hips back
3. Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch
4. Stand back up

Tip
Keep your back flat.
toe piano:
Steps
1. Stand barefoot
2. Lift all your toes, then lower them one at a time, starting with the little toe
3. Lift them one at a time, starting with the big toe
4. Repeat

Tip
Move each toe on its own.
torso-hip disassociation:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance
2. Keep your chest facing forward
3. Rotate your hips side to side
4. Keep going

Tip
Upper body stays still.
touch & go bench press:
Steps
1. Set up for a bench press
2. Lower the bar to touch your chest
3. Press straight back up
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't bounce.
towel chin up:
Steps
1. Hang towels over a bar and hold them
2. Pull up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Grip hard.
towel curl press:
Steps
1. Hold a towel with both hands, pulling it apart
2. Curl it up towards your shoulders
3. Press it overhead
4. Reverse the movement

Tip
Keep tension on the towel throughout.
towel kettlebell supination:
Steps
1. Loop a towel through a kettlebell handle and hold both ends in one hand
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh
3. Rotate your palm up, lifting the bell
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your forearm still.
towel ring row:
Steps
1. Loop towels through the rings and hold them
2. Lean back with your body straight
3. Pull your chest up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
One big towel works too.
towel taz:
Steps
1. Hold a towel at one end in each hand
2. Shake it as fast and as hard as you can
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Rest

Tip
Fast and hard on every rep.
trap bar clean pull (elevated):
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar on low platforms
2. Set a flat back
3. Explode up through your ankles, knees and hips
4. Lower with control

Tip
Arms stay long.
trap bar clean pull (floor):
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar
2. Set a flat back
3. Explode up through your ankles, knees and hips
4. Lower with control

Tip
Arms stay long.
trap bar deadlift:
Steps
1. Stand in the centre of the trap bar
2. Hinge and grip the handles, chest up, back flat
3. Push the floor away to stand tall
4. Lower with control

Tip
Push through the whole foot.
trap bar deadlift - staggered stance:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar with your feet staggered
2. Grip with a flat back
3. Stand up, driving through the front foot
4. Lower with control

Tip
Keep your back flat.
trap bar high pull:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar
2. Set a flat back
3. Explode up and pull the bar as high as you can
4. Lower with control

Tip
Power comes from the legs and hips.
trap bar jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar holding the handles
2. Lower into a quarter squat
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Use a light load that moves fast.
trap bar pendlay row:
Steps
1. Stand inside a trap bar
2. Hinge forward
3. Row it up
4. Lower back to the floor

Tip
Keep your back flat.
trapbar - drop catch jump:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar holding it at your hips
2. Release the bar
3. Re-grip and catch it before it hits the ground
4. Jump straight up from the catch

Tip
Light weight.
trapbar - drop catch split stance:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a split stance holding it at your hips
2. Release the bar
3. Re-grip and catch it before it hits the ground
4. Reset

Tip
Light weight.
trapbar alternating staggered stance jum:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a staggered stance
2. Jump and switch your stance in the air
3. Land softly
4. Reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.

Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a staggered stance
2. Jump and switch your stance in the air
3. Land on both feet
4. Reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
trapbar drop catch:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar holding it at your hips
2. Let go of the handles
3. Quickly re-grip and catch the bar before it lands
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Light weight. Keep a flat back.
trapbar split squat:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a split stance
2. Lower
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest up.
trapbar staggered stance continous cmj:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a staggered stance
2. Drop and jump
3. Land and jump again
4. Keep going

Tip
Light load that moves fast.
trapbar staggered stance counter movemen:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar in a staggered stance
2. Drop quickly
3. Jump as high as you can
4. Land softly and reset

Tip
Keep your chest up.
travelling alternating pogo hops:
Steps
1. Hop forward on one leg, then the other
2. Stay on the balls of your feet
3. Keep your knees nearly straight
4. Keep going

Tip
Quick contacts.
travelling alternating split stance pogo:
Steps
1. Stand in a split stance
2. Bounce forward, switching legs each jump
3. Keep your knees nearly straight
4. Keep going

Tip
Minimal knee bend, little time on the floor.
travelling lateral zig zag pogo jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Pogo forward diagonally left and right in a zig zag
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Keep going

Tip
Stiff ankles.
travelling pogo hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward off the ball of your foot
3. Keep your knee nearly straight
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle on contact.
travelling pogo jump - forwards & backwa:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Pogo forward a few reps
3. Then pogo backward
4. Keep the contacts fast

Tip
Stiff ankles.
travelling pogo jump - lateral:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Pogo sideways
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Go the other way

Tip
Stiff ankles.
travelling zig zag pogo hop - backward:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop backward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stiff ankle.
travelling zig zag pogo hop - forward:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep the zig zag tight.
travelling zig zag split stance pogo jum:
Steps
1. Stand in a split stance
2. Pogo forward diagonally left and right
3. Keep the contacts fast
4. Keep going

Tip
Stiff ankles.
treadmill:
Steps
1. Step on and start at a slow speed
2. Set the speed or incline prescribed
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Slow down to finish

Tip
Stand tall.
treadmill run:
Steps
1. Step on and start at a slow speed
2. Run at the pace prescribed
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Slow down to finish

Tip
Stand tall.
trigger release - piriformis:
Steps
1. Sit on a ball under one buttock
2. Cross that ankle over the opposite knee
3. Roll slowly
4. Pause on tight spots

Tip
Breathe slowly.
trigger release - plantarfascia:
Steps
1. Stand with a ball under one foot
2. Roll it slowly from heel to toes
3. Pause on tight spots
4. Switch feet

Tip
Keep the pressure comfortable.
trigger release - tfl:
Steps
1. Lie face down with a ball just below the front of your hip bone
2. Apply pressure
3. Roll slowly
4. Switch sides

Tip
Place the ball just above and outside your front pocket.
triple broad jump:
Steps
1. Stand tall
2. Broad jump forward three times in a row
3. Stick the last landing
4. Reset

Tip
Quick off the floor on the first two.
triple cross over hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg beside a line
2. Hop forward three times, crossing the line each hop
3. Stick the last landing
4. Switch legs

Tip
Stay balanced.
triple hop:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hop forward three times in a row
3. Stick the last landing
4. Switch legs

Tip
Quick off the floor.
trx deep squat breath + lat stretch:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and sit into a deep squat
2. Let your arms be pulled long
3. Breathe deeply
4. Hold

Tip
Relax as you hang from the TRX.
trx glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your heels in the TRX
2. Lift your hips
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your hips level.
trx i-y-t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms up into an I overhead
3. Return, then pull into a Y, then a T
4. Keep your body in a straight line

Tip
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
trx i-y-t - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold one TRX handle and lean back with a straight arm
2. Pull your arm overhead into an I
3. Return, then into a Y, then a T
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your body still.
trx iso hold row:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back
2. Row up
3. Hold at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Drive your elbows back.
trx push up with lateral reach:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles in a push-up position
2. Lower and push up
3. Reach one arm out to the side
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep tension in your chest.
trx push up with overhead reach:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles in a push-up position
2. Lower and push up
3. Reach one arm overhead
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your body straight.
trx t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms out to the sides into a T
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and collarbones wide.
tuck crunch:
Steps
1. Sit with your hands on the floor beside your hips
2. Lean back
3. Tuck your knees in
4. Extend

Tip
Keep it controlled.
tuck crunch - hand supported:
Steps
1. Sit with your hands on the floor beside your hips
2. Lean back
3. Tuck your knees in
4. Extend

Tip
Use your hands for support.
tyi slider push up:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with one hand on a slider
2. Lower while sliding the hand out (T), then 45 degrees (Y), then forward (I)
3. Push back up
4. One of each is 1 rep

Tip
Don't let your hips sag.
tyi slider push up - quadruped:
Steps
1. Kneel in a push-up position with one hand on a slider
2. Lower while sliding the hand out (T), then 45 degrees (Y), then forward (I)
3. Push back up
4. One of each is 1 rep

Tip
Keep your back flat.
tyre flip:
Steps
1. Squat down and grip under the tyre
2. Drive through your legs to lift it
3. Push it over
4. Reset

Tip
Keep the tyre close.
tyre skipping:
Steps
1. Stand in front of a tyre
2. Skip in and out of the tyre
3. Stay light
4. Keep going

Tip
Stay light on your toes.
underhand ez bar front raise:
Steps
1. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip
2. Raise it forward to shoulder height with straight arms
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't lean back.
underhand grip - single arm lat pulldown:
Steps
1. Sit at a cable with a single handle, underhand grip
2. Pull it down to your shoulder
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your chest up.
underhand grip cable lat pulldown:
Steps
1. Sit at the pulldown with an underhand grip
2. Pull the bar to your upper chest
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Pull to your upper sternum.
upper calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with your hands on it
2. Keep your back leg straight and heel down
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch high in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Back knee stays straight.
v squat:
Steps
1. Set up in the V squat machine
2. Lower
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back on the pad.
v-sit hold:
Steps
1. Sit and lean back
2. Lift your legs straight
3. Hold in a V shape
4. Lower

Tip
Keep your back flat.
waiters carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with a straight arm
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk for the set distance or time
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your bicep by your ear.
walk:
Steps
1. Walk at the pace prescribed
2. Stand tall
3. Swing your arms
4. Keep going for the set time

Tip
Breathe easily.
walking hamstring stretch:
Steps
1. Step one foot forward with the leg straight
2. Bend the back knee
3. Hinge forward
4. Step through and switch

Tip
Keep your front leg straight.
walking knee hug:
Steps
1. Step forward
2. Pull the other knee to your chest
3. Rise on your toes
4. Step through and switch

Tip
Keep your bottom leg straight.
walking lunge:
Steps
1. Step forward into a lunge
2. Push up and step through into the next lunge
3. Keep going
4. Stay tall

Tip
Keep your chest up.
walking quad stretch + reach:
Steps
1. Step forward
2. Grab your back foot behind you
3. Reach the other arm overhead
4. Step through and switch

Tip
Squeeze your glutes.
walking single leg rdl:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Hinge forward
3. Stand and step forward onto the other leg
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep a slight knee bend.
wall a march:
Steps
1. Place your hands on a wall and lean in at about 45 degrees
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Switch legs slowly
4. Keep going

Tip
Keep your trunk stiff and toes up.
wall a march - double switch:
Steps
1. Place your hands on a wall and lean in
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Switch legs twice quickly
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your trunk stiff.
wall a march - switch single:
Steps
1. Place your hands on a wall and lean in
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Switch legs once quickly
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your trunk stiff.
wall a march - triple switch:
Steps
1. Place your hands on a wall and lean in
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Switch legs three times quickly
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your trunk stiff.
wall a march hold:
Steps
1. Place your hands on a wall and lean in
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Hold
4. Switch

Tip
Push the wall down to keep stiff.
wall angels:
Steps
1. Stand with your back flat against a wall
2. Put your arms on the wall in a W
3. Slide them up into a Y
4. Return

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
wall assisted sl rdl - double arm:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg with your back foot touching a wall
2. Hinge forward
3. Stand back up
4. Repeat

Tip
Use the wall for feedback.
wall assisted standing ab wheel roll out:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall holding an ab wheel
2. Roll it forward
3. Go as far as you can come back from
4. Roll back

Tip
Find a distance you can control.
wall ball throw:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall holding a med ball at your chest
2. Squat down
3. Drive up and throw the ball to a target on the wall
4. Catch it and go into the next squat

Tip
Keep a steady rhythm.
wall drills (3 point load and lift with:
Steps
1. Lean into a wall at about 45 degrees with your hands on it
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Load the down leg, then lift it into two quick switches
4. Hold the finishing position

Tip
Keep your body in a straight line.
wall push up:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall with your hands on it
2. Lower your chest towards the wall
3. Push back
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your body straight.
wall sit:
Steps
1. Lean your back against a wall
2. Slide down until your knees are at about 90 degrees
3. Hold for the set time
4. Stand up slowly

Tip
Push your back into the wall.
wall sit with arms in front hold:
Steps
1. Lean your back against a wall
2. Slide down to 90 degrees
3. Hold your arms in front at shoulder height
4. Hold

Tip
90 degree depth.
wall supported single leg rdl rotations:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg with a hand on a wall
2. Hinge forward
3. Rotate your hips open, then closed
4. Return

Tip
Move slowly.
weighted back extension on roman chair:
Steps
1. Set up on the Roman chair holding a weight
2. Lower your trunk
3. Extend back up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back neutral.
weighted butterfly stretch:
Steps
1. Sit with your back against a wall and soles of the feet together
2. Place weights on your knees
3. Let them sink
4. Hold

Tip
Keep your chest up.
weighted chin-up:
Steps
1. Wear a dip belt with weight
2. Hang from a bar with an underhand grip
3. Pull your chin over the bar
4. Lower slowly

Tip
No swinging.
weighted ghd back extension:
Steps
1. Set up on the GHD holding a weight
2. Lower your trunk
3. Extend back up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your back neutral.
weighted glute ham raise:
Steps
1. Set up on the GHR holding a weight
2. Lower forward
3. Pull back up
4. Repeat

Tip
Squeeze your glutes.
weighted high plank:
Steps
1. Get into a push-up position with a plate on your back
2. Hold
3. Keep your body straight
4. Lower

Tip
Squeeze your glutes.
weighted low plank:
Steps
1. Get into an elbow plank with a plate on your back
2. Hold
3. Keep your body straight
4. Lower

Tip
Squeeze your glutes.
weighted plate tuck crunch:
Steps
1. Sit holding a plate
2. Lean back
3. Tuck your knees in
4. Extend

Tip
Keep it controlled.
weighted pull-up:
Steps
1. Wear a dip belt with weight
2. Hang from a bar with an overhand grip
3. Pull your chin over the bar
4. Lower slowly

Tip
No swinging.
weighted push up on rack - dip belt:
Steps
1. Set a bar in the rack so your body is parallel to the floor
2. Wear a dip belt with weight
3. Do push-ups on the bar
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your body straight.
weighted ring chin up:
Steps
1. Wear a dip belt with weight
2. Hang from rings
3. Pull up
4. Lower to a dead hang

Tip
Go into a dead hang each rep.
weighted roman chair back extension + tw:
Steps
1. Set up in the Roman chair holding a weight
2. Extend up
3. Twist
4. Lower

Tip
Keep your neck neutral.
weighted shoulder tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with a plate on your upper back
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your hips level

Tip
Widen your feet to make it easier.
weighted side bridge:
Steps
1. Get into a side plank holding a weight on your hip
2. Hold
3. Keep your hips up
4. Lower

Tip
Straight line from ears to ankles.
weighted side bridge - feet elevated:
Steps
1. Get into a side plank with your feet on a bench and a weight on your hip
2. Hold
3. Keep your hips up
4. Lower

Tip
Straight line from ears to ankles.
weighted side plank:
Steps
1. Get into a side plank holding a weight on your hip
2. Hold
3. Keep your hips up
4. Lower

Tip
Don't let your hips drop.
weighted single leg ghd back extension:
Steps
1. Set up on the GHD on one leg holding a weight
2. Lower your trunk
3. Extend back up
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your back neutral.
weighted sit up to stand up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back holding a weight at your chest
2. Sit up
3. Stand up
4. Lower back down

Tip
Keep it smooth.
weighted slider hamstring curl - single:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with one heel on a slider and a weight on your hips
2. Lift your hips
3. Slide out and back in
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your hips up.
weighted straight leg sit up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a weight overhead
2. Sit up
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
world's greatest stretch:
Steps
1. Step into a deep lunge
2. Put the inside hand on the floor
3. Rotate and reach the other arm to the ceiling
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your back knee off the floor.
worlds greatest stretch:
Steps
1. Step into a deep lunge
2. Put the inside hand on the floor
3. Rotate and reach the other arm to the ceiling
4. Return and switch

Tip
Keep your back knee off the floor.
worlds greatest stretch - front foot ele:
Steps
1. Put your front foot on a step and lunge
2. Put the inside hand on the floor
3. Rotate and reach the other arm to the ceiling
4. Return and switch

Tip
Same as the normal version, front foot raised.
wrist to knees crunch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent
2. Crunch up, reaching your wrists to your knees
3. Lower
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chin tucked.
zercher dumbbell straddle good morning:
Steps
1. Stand with your legs wide holding a dumbbell in the crook of your elbows
2. Hinge forward with a flat back
3. Return to standing
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your spine neutral.
zercher jefferson curl:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows
2. Tuck your chin and roll down one segment of your spine at a time
3. Go as far as you can comfortably
4. Roll back up one segment at a time

Tip
Stay braced.
zercher squat:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows
2. Squat down
3. Drive up
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your chest and elbows up.
zottman curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms forward
2. Curl them up
3. Rotate your palms down at the top
4. Lower slowly, then rotate back

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides.
